_comment: Expected sign of each primary endpoint relative to the hypothesis that motivated it. 'aligns' means the endpoint surviving project-level correction supports the claim as stated; 'contradicts' means it survives while pointing the other way, which is a refutation rather than a finding; 'unstated' means the arm made no directional promise, so survival is descriptive only. Without this, 'survives project-level BH' reads as 'supports us', which sweetspot-04 shows is wrong: its endpoint survives at p=0.013 and refutes the sweet spot.

matrix-01.claim: step-calc beats direct on arithmetic, all families

transfer-01.claim: step-calc beats direct on arithmetic, 2 families

sweetspot-04.claim: preregistered: accuracy DROPS at cap 1000; measured: it RISES (9:0)

swarm-ms.claim: bias excess grows with swarm size

coderepair-01.claim: the gain does not transfer to code repair (a null that refutes)

coderepair-02.claim: no adapted reasoning policy recovers the gain on code repair

failclosed-01.claim: seeded defects are caught, escape rate 0

swarm-fd.claim: excess persists with disagreement held fixed

transfer-confirmation.claim: step-calc beats direct on 160 fresh disjoint arithmetic items, 2/2 families, kill-switch fired

seed6-01.claim: sixth-seed swarm replication did not reproduce the excess (a null, reported as such)

collapse-replication.claim: the +0.1994 excess is not reproducible across independent runs (a null, reported as such)

confirmation-8fam-r2.claim: 7/8 families positive on 160 fresh disjoint items (1280 paired obs), signed bundle, kill-switch fired; unanimity fails informatively at qwen3:4b

prompt-ablation.claim: all four wording variants beat direct in all three families (wording-robustness, preregistered scope condition, not the core phenomenon itself)
